name: flow-statements-welcome-enrol

deploy.description: Buttondown confirmed subscriber -> one row in the Welcome Sequence Zapier Table (next_step 1, due now, status active), which flow-statements-welcome-sender works through hourly. Insert-only upsert on the lowercased email, so a second confirmation never resets a subscriber's sequence. Skips non-regular subscribers and the two known list-bombing patterns (+km<hex> plus-tags; referrer /blog/page/2/ with no form id).

trigger.trigger_note: Same app version, trigger and connection as new-buttondown-subscriber-update-in-notion, whose live claim on this combination is proven. Confirmed, not created: double opt-in keeps unconfirmed bot signups out. 63486162 is the numeric id of the 'workflowers' Buttondown connection (02b2a81f-2fcf-8e3d-9219-826e4ffe4fbe).
trigger.authentication_note: The official Buttondown app connection, used only to claim the trigger. The workflow itself never calls Buttondown.

tables.01M5M4KH7C1KCFD3CDRSAF46XA: Welcome Sequence — one row per subscriber, created 2026-10-23. Written here (insert only), read and advanced by flow-statements-welcome-sender. Columns: email (f1), subscriber_id (f2), confirmed_at (f3), next_step (f4), next_send_at (f5), last_sent_step (f6), last_sent_at (f7), status (f8), stop_reason (f9), fail_count (f10), last_error (f11).

parked_note: Parked disabled until the six refreshed sequence emails exist in Buttondown and their ids are in flow-statements-welcome-sender's SEQUENCE. Enrolling earlier would queue subscribers whose welcome email then arrives late. Enable this Zap and the sender together.
